segs.en: F. Knapsack One Million

zh.ai: F. 一百万背包

segs.en: The Orlando City Plaza Casino has released a new game for their patrons to enjoy: Knapsack One Million! In this game, a million types of random chips will be dispensed. Each type of chip will have a random size and a random value, and a million of each type of chip will be dispensed. You are then given a Knapsack One Million, which is a bag that can hold a set of chips whose sum of sizes is at most one million; that is, the capacity of the knapsack is one million.

zh.ai:
奥兰多城广场赌场推出了一款供顾客娱乐的新游戏：背包一百万！

在这个游戏中，赌场会发放一百万种随机筹码。每种筹码都有一个随机的大小和随机的价值，并且每种筹码会发放一百万枚。随后，你会得到一个“背包一百万”，这是一个可以装下一组筹码的袋子，要求这些筹码的大小总和不超过一百万；也就是说，背包的容量为一百万。

segs.en: Before testing your luck in this game, you want to analyze the best-case performance you could have in a game; however, you worry the casino might attempt to cheat by giving you a bag with a more limited capacity than advertised. Thus, for a given set of chips, you want to compute the maximum value you can achieve for all knapsack capacities between $$$1$$$ and $$$10^6$$$, inclusive.

zh.ai: 在测试自己在这个游戏中的运气之前，你想分析自己在游戏中可能取得的最佳表现；然而，你担心赌场可能会通过给你一个容量小于宣传值的袋子来作弊。因此，对于给定的一组筹码，你需要计算背包容量在 $$$1$$$ 到 $$$10^6$$$(含)之间时能够取得的最大价值。

segs.en: The first line of input will consist of a single integer $$$n$$$ ($$$n = 10$$$ or $$$n = 10^6$$$) — the number of chips. In all cases other than the sample, $$$n$$$ will equal $$$10^6$$$.

zh.ai: 输入的第一行包含一个整数 $$$n$$$($$$n = 10$$$ 或 $$$n = 10^6$$$)——芯片的数量。除样例外，所有情况下 $$$n$$$ 都等于 $$$10^6$$$。

segs.en: The following $$$n$$$ lines will consist of two integers $$$s_i$$$ and $$$v_i$$$ — the size and value of the $$$i$$$th type of chip.

zh.ai: 接下来的 $$$n$$$ 行每行包含两个整数 $$$s_i$$$ 和 $$$v_i$$$，分别表示第 $$$i$$$ 种芯片的大小和值。

segs.en: Each case (except for the sample) will be selected from a set of $$$10^6$$$ generated cases. Each case was generated such that $$$s_i$$$ and $$$v_i$$$ are uniformly randomly generated from the range $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$, inclusive. It is guaranteed that each value is generated independently. Please read the note for more details.

zh.ai: 除样例外，每个测试用例都将从一组 $$$10^6$$$ 个生成的测试用例中选取。每个测试用例的生成方式为：从闭区间 $$$1$$$ 到 $$$n$$$ 中均匀随机地生成 $$$s_i$$$ 和 $$$v_i$$$。保证每个值都是独立生成的。更多详情请阅读注释。

segs.en: Output a single line consisting of $$$n$$$ integers where for each $$$i$$$ from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$, inclusive, the $$$i$$$th integer corresponds to the maximum value of chips you can choose such that the sum of weights of the chips is at most $$$i$$$.

zh.ai: 输出一行，包含 $$$n$$$ 个整数，其中对于从 $$$1$$$ 到 $$$n$$$(包含边界)的每个 $$$i$$$，第 $$$i$$$ 个整数表示你可以选择的筹码的最大数量，使得这些筹码的重量总和不超过 $$$i$$$。

segs.en: Each testcase, except for the sample, was generated using C++'s built-in "std::mt19937" (Mersenne Twister) in combination with "std::uniform_int_distribution". The random number generator was seeded with an integer between $$$1$$$ and $$$10^6$$$ (inclusive), though the seed was not necessarily chosen at random. Items were generated independently at random: the first $$$2 \cdot 10^6$$$ values produced were used as the sizes and values of each chip type. Specifically, for the $$$i$$$-th chip, the size is the $$$(2i - 1)$$$-th value and the value is the $$$(2i)$$$-th value generated.

zh.ai: 除样例外，每个测试用例均使用 C++ 内置的“std::mt19937”(梅森旋转算法)与“std::uniform_int_distribution”生成。随机数生成器使用介于 $$$1$$$ 和 $$$10^6$$$(含)之间的整数作为种子，但该种子不一定是随机选择的。各项数据均独立随机生成：生成的前 $$$2 \cdot 10^6$$$ 个值被用作每种芯片的大小和值。具体来说，对于第 $$$i$$$ 种芯片，其大小为生成的第 $$$(2i - 1)$$$ 个值，值为生成的第 $$$(2i)$$$ 个值。

segs.en: L. Laundry Lines

zh.ai: L. 晾衣绳

segs.en: ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9a6decbd7b8e3176b8fe34b61db95f5a06225057.png)

zh.ai: ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9a6decbd7b8e3176b8fe34b61db95f5a06225057.png)

segs.en: Image by Mac, from commons.wikimedia.org

zh.ai: 图片由 Mac 制作，来源于 commons.wikimedia.org。

segs.en: As you often need to do, you are about to hang up your laundry. Having recently moved into a tiny hole of an apartment, you have only two laundry lines, both attached to the same flimsy drying rack, which tips over if one line carries much more weight than the other.

zh.ai: 正如你经常需要做的那样，你准备晾晒衣物。最近搬进了一间狭小的公寓后，你只有两根晾衣绳，而且它们都系在同一个不太牢固的晾衣架上；如果其中一根绳子承受的重量比另一根大得多，晾衣架就会翻倒。

segs.en: If you start by hanging three shirts on the same line, it might just tip over and you have to start all over again. So you must be careful about the order and manner in which you hang the laundry.

zh.ai: 如果一开始就把三件衬衫挂在同一条线上，晾衣架可能会倾倒，你就不得不重新开始。因此，你必须谨慎安排晾衣服的顺序和方式。

segs.en: This means you pick up the laundry, one piece at a time, in an order of your choosing, and hang that piece on one of the two lines. Once a piece is hung, it stays where it is.

zh.ai: 这意味着你需要按照自己选择的顺序，一次拿起一件衣物，并将其挂到两条晾衣绳中的一条上。一旦某件衣物被挂上去，就会一直保持在原处。

segs.en: At any moment, the imbalance is the absolute difference between the total weights on the two lines. You want to hang all the laundry so that the largest imbalance occurring during the process is as small as possible.

zh.ai: 在任意时刻，不平衡度是两条线上的总重量之差的绝对值。你需要将所有衣物挂上去，使整个过程中出现的不平衡度最大值尽可能小。

segs.en: Trial and error would be a very wasteful use of time, so now it is time to waste time on making an involved algorithm to take care of it instead.

zh.ai: 反复试错会非常浪费时间，所以现在该花时间编写一个复杂的算法来处理它了。

segs.en: For example, suppose you have four pieces of laundry, of weights $$$100$$$, $$$120$$$, $$$200$$$, and $$$300$$$ grams. Hanging the $$$300$$$ first gives an imbalance of $$$300$$$ straight away, but you can do better: hang the $$$120$$$ on the first line (imbalance $$$120$$$), then the $$$300$$$ on the second line (imbalance $$$180$$$), then the $$$200$$$ on the first line (imbalance $$$20$$$), and finally the $$$100$$$ on the second line (imbalance $$$80$$$). The largest imbalance during this process is $$$180$$$, which is optimal.

zh.ai: 例如，假设你有四件衣物，重量分别为 $$$100$$$、$$$120$$$、$$$200$$$ 和 $$$300$$$ 克。先挂上 $$$300$$$ 会立刻产生 $$$300$$$ 的不平衡，但你可以做得更好：先将 $$$120$$$ 挂在第一根线上(不平衡为 $$$120$$$)，然后将 $$$300$$$ 挂在第二根线上(不平衡为 $$$180$$$)，接着将 $$$200$$$ 挂在第一根线上(不平衡为 $$$20$$$)，最后将 $$$100$$$ 挂在第二根线上(不平衡为 $$$80$$$)。这一过程中最大的不平衡为 $$$180$$$，这是最优的。

segs.en: The input consists of:

zh.ai: 输入包括：

segs.en: One line with an integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \leq n \leq 16$$$), the number of pieces of laundry.

zh.ai: 一行包含一个整数 $$$n$$$($$$1 \leq n \leq 16$$$)，表示待洗衣物的件数。

segs.en: One line with $$$n$$$ integers $$$w_1, \dots, w_n$$$ ($$$1 \leq w_i \leq 1\,000$$$), the weights of the pieces of laundry in grams.

zh.ai: 一行包含 $$$n$$$ 个整数 $$$w_1, \dots, w_n$$$($$$1 \leq w_i \leq 1\,000$$$)，表示各件衣物的重量(单位：克)。

segs.en: Output the smallest possible value of the largest imbalance that occurs while hanging up all the laundry.

zh.ai: 输出晾完所有衣物过程中出现的最大不平衡度的最小可能值。
